synopsis: The booklet did not verify Korea’s national off-road automatic-braking rules, a gap stated in Chapter 3 and repeated in the glossary [f2310, f15595]. Its broader regulatory review likewise reports that relevant or dedicated rules for Korea were not found or not verified, and that no coverage or testing requirements were identified [f2136, f2813]. Korea’s regulatory status therefore remains uncertain in this research; these findings do not establish that no rules exist [f2871, f2813].

relations.note: The glossary repeats the unverified status of Korea and Indonesia’s rules.
Specifies national off-road automatic-braking rules within the broader regulatory verification gap.
Adds countries and the absence of identified coverage or testing requirements.
Extends the off-road braking gap to more countries and unidentified requirements.
The glossary’s verification gap supports the stated uncertainty about Korea’s regulatory status.
Unverified dedicated rules underpin uncertainty across the same six countries.
